title: Students at the Free University of Amsterdam and religion 1985-1986
authors: Dekker, G., Stoffels, H.C., Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Fac. godgeleerdheid (primary investigator)
contributors: VU, vereniging voor christelijk wetenschappelijk onderwijs * Amsterdam
Unie school en evangelie * Amsterdam (research initiator)
VU Amsterdam, faculteit der godgeleerdheid * Amsterdam (data collector)
descriptions: Religious developments and changes in VU-students ( students at the Free University of Amsterdam ), originating from protestant and catholic families. Role of religion and church in parental home / religious socialization in the family / atmosphere at home / relationship between parents and respondent, before as well as nowadays / participation of parents and friends in church and religion, before as well as nowadays / religious education at primary school, secondary school and at the university / newspapers which are read before as well as nowadays. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ occupation/employment/ education/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure
